sentences.en: Bill dived into the river to save the drowning child.
sentences.zh: 比尔跳入河中救起了溺水的孩子。

sentences.en: The giant plane screamed down in an almost vertical dive.
sentences.zh: 那架巨大的飞机发出尖叫声以几乎垂直的角度俯冲下来。

sentences.en: My grades had dived to the bottom of the class.
sentences.zh: 我的成绩已经跌到了班级的最底部。

senses.zh: 潜水；跳水；俯冲，（潜艇）下潜
